data.title: Waves That Knock Things Down
data.description: Taller waves and closer-together waves carry more energy. Change one thing about the paddle, enough to knock the tower down.

challenges.instruction: The first wave did not knock the tower down. Change ONE thing about the paddle so the next wave does.
